description: Live Music with Tom & Juli at Shenanigans! Grab a drink, a bite to eat, and be serenaded with classic covers and guest requests by Dahlonega's husband and wife music duo, Tom & Juli! You’ll be in good company with the tunes you know and the people you love! See y’all here every Saturday from 1-4pm! description: Holiday Celebration at NOGAWILD Step into the magic of the holiday season at North Georgia Wildlife & Safari Park! title: Dahlonega Woman's Club Meeting
description: Dahlonega Woman's Club Meeting Dahlonega Woman's Club Meetings All women of Dahlonega/Lumpkin County are welcome to join Dahlonega Woman's Club, a charitable service organization of women dedicated to strengthening the Dahlonega/Lumpkin County community and enriching lives through volunteer service and fundraising. The club meets at the historic Community House, 111 N. Park Street, Dahlonega, on the first Thursday of every month, except July and December. Please join us at 5:30 pm for fellowship and refreshments before our program and meeting. For more information, visit www.dahlonegawomansclu
